vya_text: dI0 - idAnImAhArAdigatiradhyAyaH pUrvaM darSitastamAha - atheti | yAtItyAdi | AhAraH pA~jcaBautikasvarUpo~aSanamityarthaH | taduktaM suSrute - `pa~jcaBUtAtmake#foot@-‘caturdhA ShaDrasopeto~anekavidhyupayuktakaH | dvividhoShTavidho bIjairAharaH pA~jcaBautikaH iti ‘ka’ pA0 |# dehe AhAraH pA~jcaBautikaH' iti | evaMvidhaH sa AhAraH pUrvamAdau AmASayaM yAti prApnotItyarthaH | AmASayaM ca nABistanAntare koShThaviSeShamAhuH, yathA - `nABistanAntare jantorAhurAmASayaM budhAH' iti | kIdRuSastamAha -prANAnilerita iti | prANavAyunA prerita iti BAvaH | `hRudi prANAnilo mataH' iti vacanAt | tatra ShaDrasayukto~api sa AhAro mAdhuryaM madhurarasabAhulyaM PenaBAvaM ca laBate prApnoti kaPasthAnagatatvAt, kaPo~api madhura iti prasiddhaH; ata evAha tantrAntare - BuktvAdau kaPasya vRuddhiriti rasasAdharmyAt asyaivAmAjIrNasaMj~jA, yataH `mAdhuryamannaM smRutamAmasaMj~jam iti || 1 ||

gU0 - yadA SarIrI jAtastadA AhArApekShA jAtA, ata AhArapAkakramamAha - yAtItyAdi | pUrvaM prathamataH prANAnileritaH prANavAyupreritaH AhAraH coShmAdipa~jcavidhalakShaNaH AmASayaM yAti nABistanAntaramAmASayaH tatra gatvA mAdhuryaM madhuraBAvaM PenaBAvaM ca laBate | kiMBUtaH AhAraH ShaDrasaH | vAgBaTe caivaM `Adau ShaDarasamapyannaM madhurIBUtamIrayet| PenaBAvaM rasaM jAtaM vidAhi hyamlatAM gatam' iti || 1 ||

pada: ShaShTho~adhyAyaH | athAhArAdigatiradhyAyaH | yAtyAmASayamAhAraH pUrvaM prANAnilerita: | mAdhuryaM PenaBAvaM ca ShaDraso~api laBeta saH || 1 ||

vya_text: dI0 - atha sthAnAntaraprAptimAha - atha pAcaketi | athAnantaram sa evAmASayasthitAhAraH pAcakapittena pAcakAgnitejasA vidagdhaH san pacyamAnA~aBimuKaH sannamlatAM vrajet, yato~amlAtpittaM jAyate tatrAvasthAyAM vidagdhAjIrNasaMj~jaM gatamamlaBAvamiti | AmASayAccalito~aprAptagrahaNIpado yadA Bavati tatra sthAnAntaraM vadantyeke, naivaM sarvamataM, kintu pAcakAgnisthAnasamIpavartI yadA Bavati tadA vidagdho BavatItyeke BAShante | svamate tu AmASayAvasthAyAmeva pittavaidagdhyAdamla eva syAt yataH pittavidagdhamamlatAmupaiti | idAnIM tRutIyAvasthAgatasya kAryamAha - tata ityAdi | tatastasmAtsthAnAt samAnamarutA nABigatavAyunA kRutvA grahaNIM vahnisthAnamaBinIyate prApyate AhAra iti SeShaH | etat sthAnaM kalASabdena vAcyaM yataH `ShaShThI pittadharA nAma yA kalA parikIrtitA | pakvAmASayamadhyasthA grahaNI sA prakIrtitA |' iti | grahaNyAmapi koShThavahninA kRutvA pAcyate, koShThagrahaNaM dhAtvagninirAsArtham | tasmAtkaTuko jAyate iti tAtparyArthaH | yatkaTukAjjAyate vAyuriti tadviShTabdhAjI- rNanAhurityeke | yaduktaM `ki~jcidvipakvaM BRuSatodaSUlaM viShTabdhamAnaddhaviruddhavAtam' iti || 2 ||

gU0 - amlatvaM ca prApnotItyAha -- athetyanantaraM pAcakapittena vidagdhaH amlatAM vrajet tataH samAnamarutA grahaNI aBinIyate prApyate | grahaNI kalA | grahaNyAM kiM BavatItyAha - koShThavahninA yadA grahaNyAM pacyate tadA kaTurjAyate tadvidho Bavati saMpakvAtsamyak pakvAt rasaH Bavati apakvAdAmasaMBavo BavatIti yojanA || 2 ||

pada: atha pAcakapattena vidagdhaScAmlatAM vrajet | tataH samAnamarutA grahaNImaBinIyate || 2 ||

vya_text: dI0 - atha tAdRuSasyAhArasya dvividhAmavasthAM vaktumAha - rasa iti | vahnisthAne sthitasyAhArasya samyak pAkAdraso Bavati | asamyak pAkAdAmaH samBavati iti | rasa iti samAgniparipAcitatvAt sAraBUto yo dravAMSaH sa rasa ityucyate, AmaSca aparipAkAdBavati | taduktaM `jaTharAnaladaurbalyAdavipakvastu yo rasaH | sa AmasaMj~jako dehe sarvadoShaprakopakaH' iti | idAnIM tayo rasAmayorvyApAraM darSayannAha - vahneriti | tadrasa iti pUrvoktaH, vahnerbaleneti rasagatA~agniprAbalyAt madhuratAM snigdhatAM ca yAti prApnoti sapta vAKilAn raktAdIn dhAtUn puShNAti tasmAt samyak pakvo rasaH amRutopamaH syAt | yathA `amRuto jIvano madhurAdiguNayuktaH' iti SrutiH | tathAyamapi jIvanadhAraNatarpaNAdiguNayukta ityaBiprAyaH saumyatvAt | taduktaM suSrute - `sa Kalu dravonusArI snehanajIvanatarpaNadhAraNAdiviSeShaiH saumya ityavagamyate' iti | asyaiva svarUpAntaramAha - mandavahnividagdha ityAdi | sa eva raso yadA mandavahnividagdho Bavati agnermAndyenAsamyak pakva iti BAvaH, tadA kaTuramlo vA BUtvA viShaBAvaM mAraNaM mAraNAtmakarUpatAM vrajet prApnoti | vA yadi mAraNAtmako na Bavati alpatvAttadA rogasa~gkaraM rogasastaM kuryAt doShadUShitatvAt na tu svayameva, yataH snehadagdhavyapadeSavat, taduktaM `rasAdistheShu doSheShu vyAdhayaH saMBavanti ye | te j~jAyanta ityupacAreNa tAnAhurGRutadagdhavat' iti ||3-6||

gU0 - punaH vahninA pakvaH kiM BavatItyAha - punaH vahnerbalena pakvaH mAdhuryaM snigdhatAM ca yAti, cet samyak pakvaH tadA aKilAn dhAtUn puShNAti | mandavahnipakve doShamAha - viShaBAvaM viShasvarUpaM vrajet viShUcyAdiBirmAraNAtmakatvAt | rogasaMkaraM bahurogasamUhaM vA kuryAt || 3-6 ||

pada: (ShaShThI pittadharA #foot@- prakShiptamidam |# nAma yA kalA parikIrtitA | pakvAmASayamadhyasthA grahaNItyaBidhIyate || 3 || grahaNyAM pacyate koShThavahninA jAyate kaTuH | raso Bavati saMpakvAdapakvAdAmasaMBavaH || 4 || vahnerbalena mAdhuryaM snigdhatAM yAti tadrasaH | puShNAti dhAtUnaKilAnsamyakpakvo~amRutopamaH ||5|| mandavahnividagdhaSca kaTuScAmlo BavedrasaH | viShaBAvaM vrajedvApi kuryAdvA rogasaMkaram || 6 ||

vya_text: dI0 - athAhArasya rasasAratvaM nirUpya nirasasya niHsAratvaM darSayannAha - AhArasyeti | AhArasya pUrvapratipAditasya yo raso viditasvarUpaH sa sAra ityaBihitaH, sAro muKyatvena tarpaNAdikRutatvAt sArahIna iti rasarahita AhArasyAMSo vartate sa maladravasaMj~jaH | malaM purIShaM dravaM mUtraM | tayorBinnagamanasthAnaviSeShamAha - SirABirityAdi | tajjalamiti purIShaniHsRutaM dravaviSeShaM SirABirmUtravAhinIBiH kRutvA bastau mUtrAdhAre nItaM tadeva mUtrattvamApnuyAditi BAvaH | tat kiTTaM malamiti mUtrAvaSiShTaM malaM kiTTasaMj~jakaM j~jeyaM nirdravatvAt tacca pakvASaye tiShThediti tAtparyArthaH || atha pakvASayasya sthitasya tAdRuSasya tasyAdhogamanaSIlatvaM darSayannAha - valIti | apAnena gudasthitavAyunA noditaM preritaM malamiti SeShaH, tacca valitritayamArgeNa kRutvA yAti bahirniHsaratItyarthaH | valitritayanAmAnyAha -pravAhiNItyAdi | pravAhiNI sarjanIgrAhiketi tAsAM nAmaBirevAkRutayo boddhavyA: | valayastu gudasyAvayavaBUtAstAstisro valaya uparyuparivyavasthitAH Sa~gKavartaniBA iti || 7 || 8 ||

gU0 - AhArasya kaH sAraH kiM ca malamityAha - AhArasya sAraBUto rasaH sArahIno yaH sa maladravo Bavati tajjalaM SirABiH bastau nItaM mUtratvaM ApnuyAt tatkiTTaM malaM Bavati | tasya vyavasthAmAha - tatkiTTaM tasyAhArapakvaM yatkiTTaM tanmalaM j~jeyam ? tatpakvASaye tiShThet | tat apAnena noditaM valitrayamArgeNa yAti | tasya valitritayasya nAmAnyAha - atra pramANaM noktaM tadgranthAntarAdviSeShato liKyate | tadyathA `gudasya mAnaM sarvasya sArdhaM syAccatura~ggulam | tetra syurvalayastisraH Sa~gKavartaniBAstu tAH || pravAhaNI Bavet pUrvA sA sArdhA~ggulasaMmatA | utsarjanI tu tadadhaH sAsArdhA~ggulasaMmitA || tasyA adhaH saMvaraNI syAdekA~ggulasaMmitA | ardhA~ggulapramANaM tu budhairgudamuKaM matam | malotsargasya mArgo~ayaM pAyurdehavinirmitaH ||7||8||

pada: AhArasya rasaH sAraH sArahIno maladravaH | SirABistajjalaM nItaM bastau mUtratvamApnuyAt ||7|| tatkiTTaM ca malaM j~jeyaM tiShThetpakvASaye ca tat | valitritayamArgeNa yAtyapAnena noditam || 8 || pravAhiNI sarjanI ca grAhiketi valitrayam |

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM maladravaM nirUpya sAraBUtasya rasasyApi kAryatvena sthAnAntaraprAptimAha - rasastviti | sa rasaH samAnamarutA nABigatavAyunA kRutvA IritaH UrdhvaM prerito hRudayaM yAti prApnoti, etena kimuktam ? sAraBUto raso grahaNIsthAnAt hRudayamAgacCatIti BAvaH | sakalaSarIragamanaSIlatvAt | taduktaM suSrute - `sarvadehAnusAritve~api tasya hRudayaM sthAnaM sa hRudayAccaturviMSatidhamanIranupraviSyordhvagA daSa daSa cAdhogAminya- ScatasrastiryaggAstAH kRutsnaM SarIramaharahastarpayanti, vardhayanti, dhArayanti, yApayanti, jIvayanti cAdRuShTahetukena karmaNA tasya SarIramanudhAvato~anumAnAdgatirupalakShayitavyA' iti | hRudayaSabdopalakShitamojaHsthAnamucyate | tatra so~api rasaH pittena ra~jjakapittena kRutvA pAcitaH ata eva ra~jjitaH rAgaM prAptaH san raktatAM yAti prApnoti | yato rasAdraktaM BavatIti vacanAt | raktasya BAvo raktatA | tena AdAvIShadraktaBAvaM prApya paScAtkrameNa AraktaH syAt | taduktaM - `rasaH #foot@-‘rasaH kilaikAhenaiva sampadyate dvitIye varNABaH pittasthAneShu tiShThati divase tRutIye caturthe vA yaH pravarNo Bavet pa~jcame~ahani ShaShThe vA kiMSukABaH saptame~ahani saMprApte SakragopakABaH evaM saptAhAdrasAdraktaM Bavati’ pA0 | 2 # saptAhAdarvAk parivartamAnaH SvetakapotaharitahAridrapadmakiMSukAlaktakarasapraKyaScAyaM yathAkramaM divasaparivartAdvarNaparivartamApadyamAnaH pittoShmoparAgAt SoNitatvamApadyate' iti || atha raktaprAdhAnyaM darSayannAha - raktamiti | tadraktaM sarvaSarIrasthitaM Bavati pA~jcaBautikatvAt, yataH `visratA dravatA rAgaH syandanaM laGutA tathA | BUmyAdInAM guNA hyete dRuSyante cAtra SoNite' iti | jIvasyottamamAdhAraSceti dehamUlatvAt | taduktaM - dehasya rudhiraM mUlaM rudhireNaiva dhAryate | tasmAdyatnena saMrakShyaM#foot@-‘tasmAdrakShedBi rudhiraM rudhiraM jIvamucyate’ iti pAThAntaram |# raktaM jIva iti sthitiH iti | punaH kIdRuSaM tadAha - snigdhamityAdi | snigdhamarukShaM, guru alaGu, calaM naikatrasthitiSIlaM dravatvAt | svAdu madhuraM svaBAvAt yadA vidagdhaM tadA pittavadBavet iti | yadA vidagdhaM pittamapyamlatAM vrajet kaTukaM ca Bavet tathedamapIti BAvaH | uktamanyatrA~api `anuShNaSItaM madhuraM snigdhaM raktaM ca varNataH | SoNitaM guru visraM syAdvidAhaScAsya pittavat ? iti | kAryatvenA~api tasya laGutA ca darSitA iti na doShaH || 9 || 10 ||

gU0 - iti pakvo rasaH kutra sthitvA raktAdIn karotItyAha -- samAnamaruteritarasaH Adau hRudayaM yAti tatra pittena ra~jjitaH pAcitaSca raktatAM yAti tatroBayoH sthAne raktasya hRudayapAke dUShaNaprasa~ggAt | tathAcoktaM suSrute - `sa KalvApyo raso yakRutplIhAnau prApya rAgamupaitI'tyuktatvAt || 9 || 10 ||

pada: rasastu hRudayaM yAti samAnamaruteritaH || 9 || ra~jjitaH pAcitastatra pittenAyAti raktatAm | raktaM sarvaSarIrasthaM jIvasyAdhAramuttamam || 10 || snigdhaM guru calaM svAdu vidagdhaM pittavadBavet |
pAcitAH pittatApena rasAdyA dhAtavaH kramAt ||11 || SukratvaM yAnti mAsena tathA strINAM rajo Bavet |

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM dhAtUnAmutpattiparamparApUrvakaM SukrasyApi viShayaM darSayannAha - pAcitA iti | pittatApena pittatejasA pAcitAH paripAcitA rasAdyA dhAtavaH krameNa SukratvaM mAsena yAnti prApnuvanti | rasAdyA ityatra rasagrahaNAt rasa eva SukratvaM prApnoti | ata eva yAtItyekavacanaM kRutam | AdigrahaNAt raktamAMsamedomajjAsthInIti | eke rasAdyA dhAtavo mAsena SukratvaM yAntIti paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca, teShAM mate tu kAryakAraNayoraBedopacArAt na kevalaM SukratvaM strINAmapi rajo Bavet | taduktaM `rasAdeva striyA raktaM rajaHsaMj~jaM pravartate | tadvarShAdvAdaSAdUrdhvaM yAti pa~jcASataH kShayam iti | tatheti grahaNAt Sukratvamapi strINAmeva Bavati | yato dRuSyate hi tatsrAvaNAdiBiH prayogaiH, anyathA tAsAM saMharShaH kathaM syAditi | taduktaM - saumyaM tvagASrayaM svacCaM snigdhaM yonimuKodgamam | strINAM SukraM na garBAya BavedgarBAya cArtavam' iti | mAseneti | triMSaddinairiti BAvaH | triMSaddinavivaraNaM suSrutAcAryeNoktaM tadyathA - `sa Kalu trINi trINi kalAsahasrANi pa~jca daSa ca kalA ekaikasmin dhAtavastiShThante, evaM mAsena rasaH SukrIBavati strINAM cArtavam' iti | uktamapi samuccayena darSayati - `aShTAdaSa sahasrANi saMKyA yasmin samuccaye | kalaikA navatiScoktA svatantraparatantrayoH ||' iti viMSatikalo muhUrtaH kalA daSaBAgaScetyAdinA mAsasaMKyA j~jAtavyA | etena kimuktaM rasaH kilaikAhenaiva sampadyate anye ye dhAtavaste pa~jcaBiH pa~jcaBirahoBiH sampadyanta iti BAvaH || 11||

gU0 - raktaprasa~ggena anyeShAM dhAtUnAM pakvakramamAha - pittatApena pAcitA rasAdyA dhAtavaH mAsena SukratvaM yAntIti yojyam | tathA retaHprakAreNa strINAM rajaSca mAsena Bavet | viSeShapAkakramastu dhAtuvicAraNe proktaH || 11 ||

dI0 – garBotpattimAha - kAmAditi | SuddhaSoNitaSukrajo garBo nAryAH striyAH saMjAyata iti, kutaH ? kAmAt, kAmo~aBilAShaH, kva ? mithunasaMyoge, mithunaM dvandraM strIpuruShaviShayaM tasya saMyogo melanaM tasmin sati | SuddhaSoNitaSukrayorlakShaNaM ca tantrAntare yathA - `SaSAsRukpratimaM yacca yadvA lAkShArasopamam | tadArtavaM praSaMsanti yadvAso na vira~jjayet || dinatrayaM pravRuttiSca kurute SoNitaM striyAH | vyavAyasrutaSukreNa garBastasyAstato Bavet || tadevA~atiprasa~ggena pravRuttamanRutAvapi | asRugdaraM vijAnIyAdatonyaduktalakShaNAt' iti || SuddhaM SukraM yathA - `sPaTikABaM dravaM snigdhaM madhuraM madhuragandhi ca | SukramicCanti kecittu tailakShaudraniBaM tathA' iti | `vAtAdidUShitaM pUti kuNapaM granthirUpi ca | kShINaM mUtrapurIShAByAM gandhiSukraM tu niShPalam' iti | garBa iti | SukraSoNitaM garBASayasthamAtmaprativikArasaMmUrcCitaM garBa ityucyate | sa jAto bAla ucyate iti | sa garBo yadA jAto bahirniHsarati tadA bAla ityucyate | bAlaSabdaH kanyApuruShanapuMsakeShvapi vartate | ata evAhAcAryaH - Adhikya iti | tatra ca garBASaye yadA rajasa Artavasya AdhikyaM Bavati tadA kanyA jAyate utpadyate ArtavAdhikaSukrAdityaBiprAyaH | yadi SukAdhikastarhi putraH SukrAdhikArtavAdityarthaH | samatveneti SukraSoNitayoH sAmyena samaBAgena kRutvA napuMsakaM syAt | yathA pArameSvarIcCAsti tathaiva Bavati nAtra vicAraH kartavya iti BAvaH | icCetyanenaiva yamalajAtamapi sUcitam | tadyathA - `bIje~antarvAyunA Binne dvau jIvau kukShimAgatau | yamAvityaBidhIyete dharmetarapuraHsarau' iti|| 12 || 13 ||

gU0 - SuddhaSoNitaSukrAdgarBo BavatItyapi saMkShepeNAha -- yataH aSuddhaSukraSoNitayorapi garBo Bavati ata Aha - kAmAditi | SuddhaSoNitaSukrajaH SuddhagarBaH yato vAtAdiduShTaretasaH prajotpAdane na sAmarthyam iti suSrutaH | atra SuddhaprajotpAdane na sAmarthyaM iti boddhavyam rogAdinA aSuddhAstu prajA vAtAdiduShTaSukre~api janayanti janmAndhabadhirapaMgvAdisaMBavAt | idAnIM rajaHSukrAdhikyena kiM BavatItyAha – rajasaH kanyA Bavati adhike Sukre vIrye puruShaH Bavet dvayoH sAmyena napuMsakaM Bavet ataH paraM pArameSvarI icCA adRuShTasya balavattvAt ||12-13||

pada: kAmAnmithunasaMyoge SuddhaSoNitaSukrajaH ||12|| garBaH saMjAyate nAryAH sa jAto bAla ucyate | Adhikye rajasaH kanyA putraH SukrAdhike Bavet||13|| napuMsakaM samatvena yathecCA pArameSvarI |

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM bAlasya prathamamAsAdAraBya BeShajakriyAM darSayannAha - bAlasyeti | bAlasya prathame mAsi BeShajaraktikA deyA | bAlo~atra kShIrAdaH yatastrividho bAla AShoDaSavarShAdBavati | tatra kShIrAdaH | kShIrAnnAdaH annAda iti | ata eva kShIrakShaudrasitAGRutairiti bahavo~anupAnAdayo darSitAH yathAsamBavopayogitvena | BeShajamatra suvarNarajataSilAjatvAdikaM, raktikA gu~jjA tatparimANamityarthaH | prathame mAsIti prathamagrahaNaM jAtadinamAraBya BeShajaM dadyAdityaBiprAyaH | tathAca suSrute - `atha kumAraM SItABiradBirASvAsya jAtakarmaNi kRute madhusarpiranantacUrNamiSrama~ggulyanAmikayA lehayet' iti | anantacUrNaM suvarNacUrNaM, `BeShajaraktiketi sAmAnyaBeSha- jagrahaNena granthAntaroktamapi yogacatuShTayamatra boddhavyam | tadyathA - `sauvarNaM sukRutaM cUrNaM kuShTaM madhu GRutaM vacA | matsyAKyakaH Sa~gKapuShpI madhu sarpiH sakA~jcanam || arkapuShpI GRutaM kShaudraM cUrNitaM kanakaM vacA | hemacUrNAni vaidUryai: SvetadUrvA GRutaM madhu || catvAro~aBihitAH prASAH SlokArdheShu caturShvapi | kumArANAM vapurmedhAbalabuddhivivardhanAH' iti | eke prAktanAM mAtrAmanicCatAmAmananti tanmate tu viSvAmitroktA mAtrA pracarati | tadyathA - `viDa~ggaPalamAtraM tu jAtamAtrasya BeShajam | etenaiva pramANena mAsi mAsi pravardhitam || kolA~asthimAtraM kShIrAde dadyAdBaiShajyakovidaH | kShIrAnnAde kolamAtramannAde (u)dumbaropamam' iti | avalehIkRutaikaivetyAdi | ekaiva raktikA avalehIkRutA, kaiH kRutvetyAha - kShIrakShaudrasitAGRutairiti | etena kShIrAdiBirvyastairyathAyogyaM samplAvyAvacArayedityaBiprAyaH | kShIraM strIsamBavam, AjaM vA | GRutamatra gavyam || atha meShajasyAsya vRuddhihrAsatvamapyAha - vardhayettAvadekaikAmityAdi | sA BeShajaraktikA tAvadekaikAM vardhayedyAvat vatsaro Bavati | etena pratimAsavRuddhAH dvAdaSamAseShu dvAdaSaiva raktikA BavantItyaryaH | anyadapyAha - tadUrdhvamiti | vatsarAdupari tAvanmAShakairvRuddhiryAvat ShoDaSavatsaro Bavati; etena prativarShavRudhdyA ShoDaSamAShakA BavantItyarthaH | mASho~atra mAgadhapariBAShoktaH ShaDgu~jjAparimitaH | tata iti ShoDaSavarShAdupari tAvat sthirA syAdyAvat saptativarShANi Bavanti | sthireti ShoDaSamAShakA na tu vRuddhiH | tata iti saptaterUrdhvaM saiva mAtrA bAlavacCanaiH SanairhrAsanIyA tena sA mAtrA yathaiva pUrvaM vardhitA tathaivApakarShaNIyA ityaBiprAyaH | ata eva bAlavRuddhayoH sAmyakriyA kAryeti na tu sarveShAm | kalkacUrNAdInAmiyameva mAtrA sammatA kimutAnyA vA tadAha - mAtreyamityAdi | iyaM pUrvoktA mAtrA kalkacUrNAnAM tadyogAnAM ca, kaShAyANAM caturguNA vij~jeyA | etena kimuktaM raktiparimANe catvAri raktikAH kAryAH, mAShakaparimANe caturmAShaka iti || 14-17 ||

gU0 - bAlasya BeShajapramANAdyuttarAM kriyAmAha - bAlasya prathame mAsi ekaiva BeShajaraktikA deyA | kiMBUtA BeShajamAtrA kShIrakShaudrasitAGRutaiH avalehIkRutA | yAvadvatsaro BavettAvadekAmekAM raktikAM mAsi mAsi vardhayet | vatsarAdUrdhvaM BeShajapramANamAha - tadUrdhvaM vatsarAdUrdhvaM mAShairvRuddhiH syAt yAvatShoDaSa vatsaro Bavati tAvat, ShoDaSAnantaraM sthirA mAtrA Bavet yAvatsaptati na vardhanamityarthaH | vardhanakramamaBidhAya hrAsakramamAha - tato bAlakavat ekA raktikAdimAtrAvat mAtrA hrAsanIyA UnA kartavyA | iyaM mAtrA kalkacUrNAnAM, kaShAyANAM etanmAtrAtaScaturguNA || 14-17 ||

pada: bAlasya prathame mAsi deyA BeShajaraktikA || 14 || avalehIkRutaikaiva kShIrakShaudrasitAGRutaiH | vardhayettAvadekaikAM yAvadBavati vatsaraH ||15|| mAShairvRuddhistadUrdhvaM syAdyAvatShoDaSavatsaraH | tataH sthirA BavettAvadyAvadvarShANi saptatiH || 16 || tato bAlakavanmAtrA hAsanIyA SanaiH SanaiH | mAtreyaM kalkacUrNAnAM kaShAyANAM caturguNA || 17 ||

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM tasya bAlakasyA~jjanAdikaM karma nidarSayannAha - a~jjanamiti | bAlakasyA~jjanAdi pratimarSaparyantaM janmapraBRutireva praSasyate, janmadinAdAraBya yadyatra vihitaM tat tatra kuryAditi BAvaH | a~jjanaM sauvIrA~jjanAdikaM, lepamudvartanapraBRutikaM, snAnaM pariShekaH, aBya~ggaM aBya~jjanam, vamanaM vAntiH, pratimarSena bRuMhaNamiti | aparANyAha - kavala ityAdi | kavalo gaNDUShaBedaH, sa tu pa~jcamAdvarShAdupari kAryo na tu tadarvAk | nasyakarmeti | nAsAyAM yaddIyate tannasyamiti, tasya karma kriyA caturthe, taccAShTamAdvarShAdupari kAryaM, ShoDaSavarShAdupari vireko deyaH, viSeSheNa reko vireka ityanena apUrNavIryasya koShThasya recanasya niShedhaH ShoDaSavarShAByantare Bavati | na tu mRudurecanasya niShedhaH | taduktaM `agnikShAravirekaistu bAlavRuddhau vivarjayet |' tat sAdhyeShu vikAreShu `mRudvIM kuryAllaGukriyAm' iti | viMSateScaiva maithunamiti | maithunaM strIpuruShasaMyogalakShaNaM tacca viMSativarShAdupari samAnavIryatvaM syAdityAha | tathAca - `pa~jcaviMSatitame varShe pumAn nArI tu ShoDaSe | samatvAgatavIryau tu jAnIyAt kuSalo BiShak' iti || 18 || 19 ||

gU0 - a~jjanAdInAmapi kartavyatAyAM vidhAnamAha - etada~jjanAdyaM bAlAnAM janmapraBRuti Sasyate pratimarSo nasyaBedaH mRudu na tu tIkShNaM tIkShNasya aShTamA- bdAdaBidhAnAt | idAnIM kavalAdInAM vidhAnamAha - kavalaH gaNDUShaH, pa~jcamAdvarShAtkartavyaH tasya karma aShTamAtkaryavyaM virekaH ShoDaSAdvarShAtkartavyaH, maithunaM strIprasa~ggaH viMSateH kartavyaH || 18 || 19 ||

pada: a~jjanaM ca tathA lepaH snAnamaBya~ggakarma ca | vamanaM pratimarSaSca janmapraBRuti Sasyate || 18 || kavalaH pa~jcamAdvarShAdaShTamAnnasyakarma ca | virekaH ShoDaSAdvarShAdviMSateScaiva maithunam || 19 ||

vya_text: dI0 - atha bAlyapraBRutijIvitAvasAnaM varShasaMKyayA hrAsatvamAha - bAlyamiti | tadbAlyapraBRutikaM daSata iti daSavarShAdupari hraset hAniM prApnotItyarthaH | etena kimuktaM bAlyAvasthA daSavarShAdupari, vRuddhirvardhanaM triMSadvarShAdupari, SarIraM catvAriMSadvarShAdupari, medhA tu granthAkarShaNasAmarthyarUpA pa~jcASadvarShAdupari, tvak sA SaithilyarUpA BavatIti BAvaH | ShaShTivarShAdupari dRuShTiH, saptativarShAdupari vikramaM tacca sAhasAdirUpaM parAkramasaMj~jam | navativarShAdupari buddhiH, SatavarShAdupari karmendriyam, daSAdhikaSatavarShAdupari cetaScetanasthAnaM, viMSatyadhikaSatavarShAdupari jIvitaM prANamiti| tena viMSatyadhikaSataM paramAyurmanujAnAM BavatIti tAtparyArthaH | taduktaM - `samAH ShaShTirdviGnA manujakariNAM pa~jca ca niSA, hayAnAM dvAtriMSatKarakaraBayoH pa~jcakakRutiH | virUpA satyAyurvRuShamahiShayordvAdaSa SunaH smRutaM CAgAdInAM daSakasahitaH ShaT ca paramam || 20 ||

gU0 - bAlyAvasthAdIni kiyatparyantaM Bavanti tadapyAha - bAlyAdikaM jIvitAntaM daSataH hraset hIno Bavet; bAlyaM daSavarShaparyantaM; vRuddhiH viSatiparyantaM, Cavi: triMSatparyantaM, medhA catvAriMSatparyantaM, tvakdAryaM(dArDhyaM) pa~jcASatparyantaM, dRuShTiH ShaShTiparyantaM hInA Bavati, SukraM saptatiparyantaM, vikramaH aSItiparyantaM, SuddhiH navatiparyantaM, karmendriyaM SataparyantaM, ceto manaH, smRutirdaSottaraparyantaM, jIvitaM jIvitapramANaM viMSottaraSataparyantam | [ nanu SAr~ggadhareNa#foot@yadyapi koShTakAntargataH pAThaH 14 Slokasya TIkArUpaH atastatraiva mudrayitumupayuktastathApi madRUShTamAtRukAMsvatraiva liKitatvAttathaivehApi mudritaH | # `bAlyasya prathame mAsi deyA BeShajaraktike'ti janmottarakAle vidhAnaM liKitaM, tatkiM asvasthaviShayaM vA svasthaviShayaM vA ? asvasthaviShayaM cettadA bAlacikitsAyAmeSha prasa~ggaH syAt, svasthaviShayaM cettadA svasthe rogaM vinA auShadhadAnAsaMBavAdvyarthametadvidhAnam ? ucyate, stanyAvataraNe doShakopo Bavati tannivAraNArthaM, yadvA prakRutyAramBakadoShaduShTanivAraNArthaM vA etadvidhAnaM doShakopAt | tathAca - sadyaHprasUtAnAM kShIraMguNe 'kShIraM sadyaHprasUtAnAM virasaM doShakArakam | tasmAtsadyaHprasUtAnAM jAyate SlaiShmikaM payaH iti | ato yaduktaM vidhAnaM tadavaSyamatraivocitam | tathAca suSrute liKitaM tasmAtprathame~ahani madhusarpiranantamiSraM mantrapUtastrikAlaM pAyayet, dvitIye lakShmaNAsiddhaM sarpiH, tRutIye ca tataH prAgnivAritastanyaM madhusarpi: svapANitalasammitaM dvikAlaM pAyayet | anantaH keSara~jja(kaM) suvarNaM vA | vRuddhavAgBaTe tu `anantAmiSre madhusarpiShI ? iti pAThaH | tatra cAnantA dUrvA vyAKyAtA, tatra rAktikAmAtraM deyaM | anye ca prayogAH - `sauvarNaM sukRutaM cUrNaM kuShThaM madhuGRute vacA | matsyAkShakaH Sa~gKapuShpI madhusarpiH sakA~jcanam || arkapuShpI GRutaM kShaudraM cUrNitaM kanakaM vacA | hemacUrNAni vaiduryaH SvetA dUrvA GRutaM madhu | catvAro~aBihitAH prASAH SlokArdheShu caturShvapi | kumArANAM vapurmedhAbalapuShTivivardhanAH ||' saMvatsaraM yAvadete yogAH sevyAH, anye dvAdaSavarShANyAhuH | suSrutAdetat | uktatyauShadhAni vyAKyAyante | sauvarNacUrNaM nAgakeSaracUrNaM yadvA kuMkumacUrNaM, matsyAkShakaH maCeMCI, brAhmI ca, arkapuShpI payasyA yadvA arkapuShpI ISalatA, SvetA dUrvA, SvetetiviSeShaNam, yadvA kecidvacAmAhuH, vaiduryaH niMmbaH, kanakavAcakaM sarvatra keSarameva | mAtrApi liKyate `viDa~ggaPalamAtraM tu jAtamAtrasya BeShajam | etenaiva pramANena mAsimAsi vivardhanam || kolamAtraM ca kShIrAderdadyAdBaiShajyakovidaH | kShIrAnnAdeH kolamAtramanne codumbaropamam |' iti kumArapoShaNavidhAnam || 20 ||

pada: bAlyaM vRuddhiSCavirmedhA tvagdRuShTiH Sukravikramau | buddhiH karmendriyaM ceto jIvitaM daSato hraset||20||

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM prakRutilakShaNamAha - alpetyAdi | vAtaprakRutiko nara IdRuSo Bavati kIdRuSastamAha - alpakeSa iti | tucCakeSaH adIrGakeSa ityanye, yato vAtasyAtiraukShyatvena tvakpAruShyAdalpakeSatvam | punaH kIdRuSaH ? kRuSo durbalaH, vAtasya SoShakatvAt rUkShaguNatvAdasnigdhaH, vAcAla iti pravacanaSIlaH, calamAnasa iti ca~jcalacittaH, vAtasya calaguNatvAt svapneShvapi AkASacArI BavatIti yathA vAyurAkASe caratIti svaBAvAt | prakRutistu svaBAva evetyAhurAcAryAH, yataH - `SukraSoNitasaMyoge yo BaveddoSha utkaTaH | prakRutirjAyate tena tasyA me lakShaNaM SRuNu' iti ||21||

gU0 - atha prakRuterapi SarIrA~ggatvAt SArIre prakRutivivaraNamAha - nanuprakRutistu pUrvoktA jagatkartrI, ityASaMkya kathamatra na punaruktidoShaH, ucyate, iyaM tu SarIrasvaBAvalakShaNA prakRutiH SukArtavasaMyoge doShotkRuShTajanyA saptavidhA | tathAca suSrute liKitaM - `SukaSoNitasaMyoge yo BaveddoSha utkaTaH| prakRutirjAyate tena tasyA me lakShaNaM SRuNu ||' vAgBaTe ca `SukrAsRukgarBiNIBojyaceShTAgarBASayArtiShu | yaH syAddoSho~adhikastena prakRutiH saptadhoditA |' saptadhA prakRutirityuktervAtaprakRutimAha - alpakeSa iti | evaMBUto naraH vAtaprakRutiko BavatIti yojanA | rUkShaH rUkShA~ggaH, vAcAlaH bahujalpakaH, calamAnasaH calacittaH, svapneShu AkASacArI AkASaBramaNaSIlaH, naraSabdo~atra sAmAnyamanuShyavAcakaH strIpuMviShayaH | yataH strINAM BinnA prakRutirnoktA || 21 ||

pada: alpakeSaH kRuSo rUkSho vAcAlaScalamAnasaH | AkASacArI svapneShu vAtaprakRutiko naraH || 21 ||

vya_text: dI0 - atha pittaprakRutimAha - akAlapalitairiti | pittaprakRutiko nara IdRuSo Bavati | kIdRuSastamAha - akAlapalitairvyApta iti | akAle asamaye palitairvArdhakyairvyAptaH pittasyoShmaguNatvAt | taduktaM - `krodhaSo- kaSramakRutaH SarIroShmA SirogataH | pittaM ca keSAn pacati palitaM tena jAyate' iti | punaH kIdRuSaH ? dhImAn buddhimAn sattvaguNabAhulyAt, svedIti | prasvedayukta:, pittasyoShmamayatvAt dravaguNatvAcca | roShaNa iti | roShayuktaH pittasya tIkShNatvAt svapneShvapi jyotiShAmagnyAdInAM tArakAdInAM ca draShTA avalokaka: yattatpittamuShNamuktaM tattadguNatvAt || 22 ||

gU0 - atha pittaprakRutimAha - akAleti | evaMBUto naraH pittaprakRutiko BavatIti yojyam | akAle taruNAvasthAyAM palitaiH SvetaiH, ( vyAptaH) dhIrdhAraNAvatI buddhistadyuktaH, svedI prasvedabahulaH, roShaNaH krodhAluH, svapneShu jyotiShAM jyotIrUpANAm (draShTA) || 22 ||

pada: akAlapalitairvyApto dhImAnsvedI ca roShaNaH | svapneShu jyotiShAM draShTA pittaprakRutiko naraH || 22 ||

vya_text: dI0 - atha kaPaprakRutiko nara IdRuSo Bavati, kIdRuSastamAha - gamBIrabuddhiriti | gamBIrabuddhiH gamBIrA atalasparSA sarvakAryakShamA buddhiryasya sa tathA | kaPasya tamoguNAdhikatvAt sthUlA~gga: sthUlaSarIraH, medo~adhikatvAt, yataH kaPastu medovRuddhermUlameva | snigdhakeSa iti | tasya snehaguNatvAt, mahAbala iti ojasA SarIre karmasAmarthyam, yataH dhAtUnAM yatparaM tejastattvojastadeva balamityucyate, ata eva kaPabAhulyAcCukraM SukrAyattaM balamiti vacanam | svapne jalASayAlokIti | jalASayaM nadInadataDAgAdikaM kaPasya saumyaguNatvAt || idAnIM dvidoShajatridoShajaprakRuterlakShaNAni darSayannAha - j~jAtavyA iti | miSracihnairmilitalakShaNaiH kRutvA dvitridoSholbaNA narA boddhavyAH, tena pUrvoktayordoShayormilitalakShaNairdvidoShajA prakRutirj~jeyA ityaBiprAyaH, trayANAM doShANAM militalakShaNaistridoShajA prakRutiravagantavyeti BAvaH || 23 ||

gU0 - atha SleShmaprakRutimAha -- gamBIrabuddhiriti | evaMBUto naraH SleShmaprakRutiko BavatItyatrApi yojanA | kiMBUtaH ? gamBIrabuddhiH gamBIrA aca~jcalA buddhiryasya, jalASayA~alokI jalasthAne AlokayatIti saH | atha dvidoShatridoShaprakRutimAha -miSradoShairdvidoShacihnaiH dvandvajAstrayaH tridoShaja ekaH, evaM saptaprakRutayaH | iti prakRutiBAgaH | vAtA- diprakRutivatsatvAdayo~api sapta prakRutaya ityeke | tathAca vAgBaTe - `SaucAstikyAdiBiScaiva guNairguNamayIM vadet|' tathAca suSrute - `mahatprakRutayastvanyAstamaHsatvarajaHkRutA: | proktA lakShaNataH samyak BiShak tASca viBAvayet || tA Aha - `sAtvikAH sapta viKyAtA rAjasAH ShaT prakIrtitAH | tisrastu tAmasAH proktAstAsAM lakShaNamucyate || vAgBaTena puna`rhInamadhyottamaSreShThanindya' ityevaM BedaBUtA api uktAH | tadyathA - `SukrArtavasya janmAdau viSeSheNa (ca) vikramaH | tASca prakRutayastisro hInamadhyottamAH pRuthak ||' samadhAtuH samastAstu samadhAtuH samadoShaH SreShThaH, dvidoShajA nindyA: | nanu prakRutistu rajaHSukrasaMyoge doShAdhikyena BavatIti | atha ca ekA sannipAtajA Bavati teByo maraNaM kathaM na syAdityata Aha - `viShajAto yathA kITo na viSheNa vipacyate | tadvatprakRutayo martyaM Saknuvanti na bAdhitum || idaM tu vAgBaTe liKitaM, suSrute tu - `prakopo vA~anyaBAvo vA kShayo vA nopajAyate | prakRutInAM svaBAvo~ayaM jAyate gurutAyuShaH ||' iti prakRutivivaraNaM samAptam || 23 ||

pada: gamBIrabuddhiH sthUlA~ggaH snigdhakeSo mahAbalaH | svapne jalASayAlokI SleShmaprakRutiko naraH || 23 || j~jAtavyA miSracihnaiSca dvitridoSholbaNA narAH |

vya_text: dI0 - adhunA SarIravicAraprasa~ggena nidrAdInAmapi viSeShotpattimAha - tama iti | nidrA svapnaH sA tamaHkaPAByAM syAt tamoguNakaPasaMsargeNa BavatItyarthaH | pittatamoBavA mUrcCA, mUrcCA ca rUpAdyavij~jAnaM mohasaMj~jakaM acetanarUpetyarthaH | yadyapi vAtAdiBistriBirdoShai: SoNitena, madyena, viSheNa ca mUrcCABimatA, tathApi tasyAH pittapradhAnatvena darSitatvAt | taduktam - `vAtAdiBiH SoNitena madyena ca viSheNa ca | ShaTsvapyetAsu pittaM tu praButvenAvatiShThate' iti | rajaHpittAnilaiH kRutvA BrAntiH BramaNaM, taduktam - `yonAyAsaH Sramo dehe pravRuddhaH SvAsavarjitaH | BramaH sa iti vij~jeya indriyArthaprabAdhakaH' iti | SleShmatamonilaiH kRutvA tandrA syAt | tandrA nidrABramaH, taduktam, - `indriyArtheShvasamprAptigauravaM jRumBaNaM klamaH| nidrArtasyeva yasyehA tasya nidrAM vinirdiSet' iti ||24||

gU0 - nidrAdayo~api SarIrasamBavA ataH SArIraprakaraNe tamaHkaPAByAM nidrA syAdBavet | pittatamoBavA mUrcCA syAt| rajaHpittAnilaiH BrAntiH syAt | BrAntirBramaH SleShmatamonilaistandrA syAditi yojanA | atrAnukrameNApi nidrAlakShaNamAha - `indriyANAM ca manaso moho nidrABidhIyate' | carake ca `yadA tu manasi krAnte sarvAtmAnaH kramAnvitAH | viShayeByo nivartante tadA svapiti mAnavaH ||' suSrute ca `hRudayaM cetanAsthAnamuktaM suSruta ! dehinAm | tamo~aBiBUte tasmiMstu nidrA viSati dehinam || nidrAhetustamaH satvaM bodhane heturucyate |' iti nidrA | mUrcCA rUpAdyavij~jAnam | tathAca tantrAntare - `saMj~jopadhAturmUrcCA syAnmUrcCitaM'….tathA | kaSmalaM pralayo mohaH, saMnyAsastu mRutopamaH' iti mUrcCA | BrAntirBramaH | tallakShaNam BramaScakrArUDhasyeva viparItapadArthaj~jAnaM ca BramaH || atha tandrAlakShaNaM granthAntarAt-`indriyANAM ca manaso mohastandreti kathyate' | suSrute vAgBaTe ca tandrAlakShaNaM-`kaPolbaNo vAyunoddhUto dhamanI saMnirudhya ca | kuryAtsaMj~jApahA tandrA dAruNA mohakAriNI | unmIlitavinirBugne parivartitatArake | Bavatastatra nayane lulite calapakShmaNI | arvAk trirAtrAtsAdhyA sA na sAdhyA tu tataH param |? iti tandrAlakShaNam || 24 ||

pada: tamaHkaPAByAM nidrA syAnmUrcCA pittatamoBavA||24|| rajaHpittAnilairBrAntistandrA SleShmatamonilaiH |

vya_text: dI0 - atha glAnimAha - glAniriti | glAnistu klamAparaparyAyavAcako harShakShaya ityarthaH | sa ca kAraNa- catuShTayAdBavati, kiM tat kAraNacatuShTayam ? ojaHkShayAdityAdi | ojaH Sukram aSeShadhAtudhAmABiSabditamoja ityeke, tasya kShayAdbalakShayAditi spaShTArthaH | duHKAditi | mAnasodvegAdikarmaNaH | tacca duHKaM trividhamiti suSrutaH, AdhyAtmikamAdhidaivikamAdhiBautikamiti, eShAM vivaraNaM na liKitamatra #foot@AdhyAtmikaM dvividhaM SArIraM mAnasaM ca | SArIraM vAtapittaSleShmaNAM vaiShamyanimittaM, mAnasaM - kAmakrodhaloBamohaBayerShyAviShAdaviShayA- viSeShAdarSananibandhanam | antaropAyasAdhyamidam | bAhyopAyasAdhyaM ca duHKaM dvedhA AdhiBautikamAdhidaivikaM ca | AdhiBautikaM - mAnuShapaSupakShisarIsRupa- sthAvaranimittam | AdhidaivikaM ca yakSharAkShasavinAyakagrahAveSanibandhanam | tadetatpratyAtmavedanIyaM duHKaM rajaHpariNAmaBedo na Sakyate pratyAKyAtum ||# vistaraBayAt | ajIrNAdityaparipakvAnnasvarUpAt | etadapi trividhaM caturvidhaM vA | trividhamannajaM viShTabdhAdisaMj~jaM caturthaM rasaSeShamiti | SramAditi | SarIrAyAsajananakarmaNaH | sa ca vyAyAmAparaparyAyavAcakaSabdena kathitaH, `SarIrAyAsajananaM karma vyAyAma ucyate' iti | glAnilakShaNaM tu prasa~ggAttantrAntarIyoktam - `vakre madhuratA tandrA hRudayodveShTanaM klamaH | na cAnnamaBikA~gkSheta glAniM tasya vinirdiSet' iti | (prasa~ggAt#foot@bandhanIdhRutaH pATho nAsti ‘ka’ pustake | # tantrAntarIyoktaM klamalakShaNaM yathA - `yo~anAyAsaH Sramo dehe pravRuddhaH SvAsavarjitaH | klamaH sa iti vij~jeya indriyArthaprabAdhakaH' iti |) athA~alasyamAha - ya iti | sAmarthye karmaNi sAmarthye sati yo~anutsAho~apraharShaH sa AlasyaSabdena vAcyaH | lakShaNamasyoktaM yathA - `suKasparSaprasa~ggitvaM duHKadveShaNalolatA | Saktasya cApyanutsAhaH karmaNyAlasyamucyate' iti || 25 ||

gU0 - atha glAnilakShaNamAha -- ojaHkShayAdyairglAnirBavediti yojanA | glAniSabdastu klamavAcakaH, `klamu glAnau' iti dhAtorarthatvAt | tallakShaNaM yathA - `yo jAyate Sramo dehe pravRuddhaH SvAsavarjitaH | klamaH sa iti vij~jeya indriyArthaprabAdhakaH' iti klamaH| athAlasyalakShaNamAha - sAmarthye~api yaH anutsAhaH tadAlasyaM udIryate iti yojyam | ityAlasyalakShaNam || 25 ||

dI0 - idAnIM jRumBAlakShaNamapyAha - caitanyeti | puruShaScaitanyaSithilatvAt caitanyaSithilIBAvAt caitanyasya j~jAnalakShaNasya SithilIBAvaM kiMcinnyUnatAmanuBUya iva sthitaH san vidIrNavadano vyAttamuKo BUtvA ekaM SvAsamUrdhvagataM pItvA aparaM SvAsamadhogataM yaduddharet tyajet sA budhaiH paNDitaiH suSrutAdiBirjRumBA iti kathyate | jumBAkAle udveShTanaM netrASrusravaNaM ca boddhavyam, yaduktaM suSrutena - `pItvaikamanilaM SvAsamudveShTan vivRutAnanaH | yanmu~jcati sanetrAmBaH sa jRumBa iti kIrtitaH || cittasya viShayAntaravyAsaktivinivRuttaye jRumBAkAle CoTikAdAnaM laukikaM siddham, vacanaM hi - `kShudutpatanajRumBAsu jIvatiShThA~ggulidhvaniH' iti || atha CikkAlakShaNaM darSayannAha -udAneti | ya udAnaprANayorUrdhvayogAt mUrdhni srotaHpathasthitAt kaPasravAcca yaH SabdaH saMjAyate utpadyate tena Sabdena kShutaM CikkA kathyate budhairiti SeShaH | teneti sthAne nasta iti paThantyeke, tatra nasto nAsikAtaH | anyatrApyuktaM `prANodAnau ca tau syAtAM mUrdhni srota:pathasthitau | nastaH pravartate SabdaH kShutaM tadaBinirdiSet iti || 26 || 27 ||

gU0 - atha jRumBAlakShaNam - yaH vidIrNavadanaH caitanyaSithilatvAt cetanABUtA vA dehaceShTA tasyAH SithilaBAvAt | iti jRumBAlakShaNam | atha kShullakShaNam - maulikaPasravAt udAnaprANayorUrdhvayogAdyaH nastaH nAsikAtaH SabdaH saMjAyate tatkShutaM budhaiH kathyate iti yojanA | maulikaPasravAt mastakakaPasravAt, udAnakaNThastho vAyuH tayorUrdhvagamanAt, kShutamiti CikkAsaMj~jitam | itikShullakShaNam || 26 || 27 ||

pada: caitanyaSithilatvAdyaH pItvaikaM SvAsamudvamet ||26|| vidIrNavadanaH SvAsaM jRumBA sA kathyate budhaiH| udAnaprANayorUrdhvayogAnmaulikaPasnavAt || 27|| Sabda: saMjAyate nasta: kShutaM#foot@-‘tena’ ka |# tatkathyate budhaiH |

vya_text: dI0 – athodgAramAha - udAnakopAditi | AhArasvasthitatvAcceti AhAro~aSanaM tasya svasthAne yadA sthitirBavati tasmAdityarthaH | pavanasya vAyoryadUrdhvagamanaM Bavet tamudgAraM pracakShata iti BAvaH | udAnavAyoreva prakopaH | prakopAdeva tasyaivordhvagamanamityAcakShate | samAnavAyorUrdhvagamanamityeke || 28 || iti SrIvAstavyAnvayaprakASavaidyaBAvasiMhAtmajenADhamallena viracitAyAM SAr~ggadharadIpikAyAM prathamaKaNDe AhArAdigatirnAma ShaShTho~adhyAyaH || 6 ||

gU0 – athodgAralakShaNam - udAnakopAt pavanasya yadUrdhvagamanaM Bavet tamudgAraM (pra)cakShate iti yojanA | kasmAdAhArasya susthitatvAt || 28 || iti SrIkASIrAmavaidyaviracitAyAM SAr~ggadharagUDhArthadIpikAyAmAhArAdigatiradhyAyaH || 6 ||

pada: udAnakopAdAhArasvasthitatvAcca yadBavet ||28|| pavanasyordhvagamanaM tamudgAraM pracakShate | iti SrIdAmodarasUnunA SAr~ggadhareNa viracitAyAM SAr~ggadharasaMhitAyAM SArIre AhArAdigatiradhyAyaH || 6 ||
